description:
Cast Cloudshift by paying {W}, targeting Archaeomancer.
Docent of Perfection triggers, creating a 1/1 Human Wizard token.
Resolve Cloudshift, blinking Archaeomancer.
Archaeomancer enters the battlefield, returning Cloudshift from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Human Wizard, adding {W}.
Repeat.
